integrity: All displayed identities are derived from the stated six-edge polygon and the planar mixed-area formula. The result is restricted to the explicit family; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact profile only for the stated planar triangle family with disjoint vertex cuts and removed-area fraction \(q\in(0,1/2)\); it is not a stability theorem for arbitrary convex bodies or a higher-dimensional extension. The closest published-finding corpus record pages were inaccessible beyond their returned titles and summaries, so broader poorly indexed multi-cut formulas remain a residual originality risk.
title: Exact three-cut Godbersen deficit profile for a triangle
